notes:
World boss respawn times are read off the wire. The client only schedules twelve bosses out of eighty-five - the Abyss ones - and asks the server for the rest, once a second, for as long as the world map is open. The meter now reads that answer and keeps it: open the map in a zone and its bosses are recorded, they survive a restart, and they outrank the client's own table while they are still ahead of you. Which bosses you are told about, and how early, is chosen per boss in the respawn table itself - every one of them is silent until you choose.

Alerts have their own settings tab, and they work at all: the notifier referenced four identifiers that were never declared, so it threw on construction and was silently discarded - which is why every checkbox in that panel appeared to do nothing. Each event can be given one of ten sounds, and picking one plays it. The speaking voice can be chosen too, with speed and pitch.

Combat Power was being guessed: the first number in range after the name was taken as CP, which showed 35k as 90.5k, and a ceiling of 999,999 meant a player past a million had his real value rejected and a neighbouring field shown instead - 1.02m appeared as 110k. It is read from an anchored position now, or not at all.

Updating is one click: the meter downloads the installer, checks it and runs it, instead of opening a download page for you to do it by hand.

An Elementalist's spirit no longer appears as a second summoner in the meter, in history or in the upload. Rank changes in the top-DPS list now slide instead of jumping. Long dropdowns in the history filters open over the meter and can be scrolled - a native list that size was being drawn behind the window. The world boss table counts down live instead of only when reopened.
